title: Maple Muse Spark

diffuser.notes: Diffuse during creative sessions; refresh after 30–45 minutes.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; mist away from face.

why_it_works: Bright grapefruit lifts the mood, rosemary supports clear focus, and a touch of black pepper adds warm spark—an invigorating scent for hobby time.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
